decisions.reason: As a flagship transactional email service shown on the home page, it fits the firm's strategic direction and its high-volume messaging core, so it likely meets aspirations and calls for no problemistic search.
Managed capture has a dedicated page and a reported customer adoption, which is evidence of performance near aspiration, and it supports the firm's push toward digital document workflows.
Email and fax conversion is a low-cost extension of the established fax and email infrastructure that serves regulated customers, and a growing industry gives enough slack to carry it.

The fax delivery optimization feature is embedded in the core fax service and costs little to maintain, although fax demand is declining over the long term, so the risk of dropping it is somewhat higher.

Sandbox threat protection addresses rising security demand and strengthens the email security suite, so it likely performs at or above aspiration, unlike the multi-engine scanning feature that was already dropped.
